reviewScope.summary: PR #54, ACH-01. Review of committed ten-file Activity narrative delivery, head 677e067e4f68c74d2f45fcf8c9a1c5ccda699def, against master 35214e45b0b0ffdf2444e48934f3612b1468b087. Review conducted through technical, UX, accessibility, security, adversarial and retrospective lenses. Owner-approved ChatGPT model review, not an independent human review.
evidence: Reviewed complete GitHub PR #54 diff and committed source of reward event mapping, provider, panel, gallery and modified Activity Playwright test. GitHub reports ten changed files and no changes to persistence, schema, activity achievement conditions, XP or approved fiction definitions.

New Activity events derive narrative from the original activity.fiction only on committed unlockedAchievements; message retains activity.unlock for backward compatibility. Normal level and non-Activity achievement events remain transient.

NotificationProvider collects multiple Activity unlocks into one in-memory deduplicated panel and leaves the original ~3.3s queue for ordinary events. Reload does not replay stories; newly earned and historic awards share unchanged unlock data.

The non-modal, non-timed panel includes title, badge art, exact fiction and keyboard-operable dismiss control; story copy stays accessible in the unlocked Achievements card. CSS constrains panel width, scrolling and narrow-viewport height and does not install a focus trap.

Owner-provided Windows transcript at commit 677e067e4f68c74d2f45fcf8c9a1c5ccda699def: 37 targeted Vitest tests in 4 files passed, Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build and bundle checks passed; total JS gzip 465725/470000; zero bundle violations and warnings. Reviewer did not independently execute these tests.

Focused browser spec was changed but not executed locally. Actual mobile rendering, screen-reader announcement quality, repeated-click overlap and full E2E integration remain contingent on GitHub Final candidate.

Hosted GitHub Actions run 41042834291 stopped before full validation because no review evidence matched exact payload tree 310bec567a61a4350e6816debdab4ef2b526a6bb. This was a binding failure, not a demonstrated product failure.
Owner decision dated 2026-10-30 accepts transparently attributed multidisciplinary ChatGPT review where no material blocker is identified.

adversarialFindings.description: A long narrative placed only in an auto-disappearing toast could not be read or revisited.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Story uses a manually dismissible reading panel, and fiction is visible inline for unlocked awards in the gallery.

adversarialFindings.description: Multiple simultaneous Activity unlocks could cause a backlog of modal or timed notices.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Events accumulate in one non-modal scrollable panel, deduplicated by achievement ID; legacy non-Activity queue is unchanged.

adversarialFindings.description: Unlock narrative might replay on reload or alter achievement data.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Narrative panel is ephemeral and generated only from newly committed unlock events; no persistence/schema/unlock-history modifications.

adversarialFindings.description: A fixed-position story panel may temporarily cover underlying controls, especially on narrow screens, and screen-reader announcement behavior is not browser-certified.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Panel is dismissible, has bounded height and responsive width, no backdrop or focus trap; underlying UI remains operable outside overlay. Dedicated browser test and complete hosted certification still must validate actual usability. If CI exposes a material regression, stop release rather than weaken checks.

adversarialFindings.description: This same-conversation AI review lacks independent human authorship.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Reviewer provenance is explicit. Owner authorizes proportionate model roundtable review, without bypassing release certification.

retrospective.summary: Bounded review supports proceeding to authoritative hosted release certification, not immediate merge or production promotion. No independent human review, browser certification, or production readiness is claimed. Avoid extra owner review loops unless CI reveals a substantive defect.
